title: AWS Devops Engineer - Working within a team building Agentic AI Products!
description:
DB Recruitment is delighted to present a DevOps engineering opportunity within a leading Agentic AI product team based in Dublin City Centre.
This is a unique opportunity to join a really cool company who are at the early stages of their Irish growth journey (with big plans to grow!). 
The ideal candidate will have:Strong experience architecting & managing AWS solutions. AWS Certifications (DevOps Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Security Specialty).Experience in regulated environments (FedRAMP, HIPAA, SOC2).Familiarity with Zero Trust architectures and secrets management.Experience implementing policy-as-code and compliance automation tools.
Great learning opportunity with strong package on offer. DM me here or reach out to claire@db-recruitment.ie for more info. Candidates must be based in Ireland to be considered ☘️ This is a hybrid role requiring 2-3 days onsite in Dublin City Centre.
